# Flowdence Docs

> Official documentation for Flowdence products — ApprovalFlow, MuleSight, GrafanaSight, BoomiSight, and WorkatoSight for Atlassian Confluence Cloud.

## Documentation Structure

This site contains setup guides, feature references, policies, and trust resources for all Flowdence products.

## Products

### ApprovalFlow for Confluence
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/approvalflow
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2350565795/approvalflow-for-confluence
- Description: Structured content approval workflows for Confluence Cloud. Multi-step review processes, version-aware page tracking, workflow analytics, and audit trails.

### MuleSight for Confluence
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/mulesight
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/970479047/mulesight-for-confluence
- Description: MuleSoft Anypoint visibility in Confluence. Live snapshot macros, environment drift detection, API security posture analysis, and Rovo AI agent.

### GrafanaSight for Confluence
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/grafanasight
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2643908494/grafanasight-for-confluence
- Description: Grafana Cloud visibility in Confluence. Panel snapshots, dashboard and alert context, annotations, sync health, and a cache-first Rovo Specialist for runbooks and incident reports.

### BoomiSight for Confluence
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/boomisight
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2126489539/boomisight-for-confluence
- Description: Boomi operational and documentation context in Confluence. Dashboards, page-aware Documentation Health, safe Process Property and XREF structure, verified relationships, runbook macros, and a cache-first BoomiSight Specialist.

### WorkatoSight for Confluence
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/workatosight
- Marketplace: Marketplace listing pending approval
- Description: Workato operational visibility in Confluence. Cache-backed dashboards, native macros, Workato architecture and API bylines, dependency context, runtime evidence, and documentation coverage for Workato estates.
